versions.changelog:
Initial release of the pdf-to-structured-json skill, providing intelligent, zero-configuration document parsing to structured JSON using Laiye ADP.

- Parses 10+ document formats (PDF, images, Office files) with a single command, outputting structured JSON.
- Includes step-by-step installation, authentication, and usage instructions.
- Supports local, remote URL, base64, batch, and async parsing modes.
- Ideal for document storage, retrieval, automated pipelines, quality inspection, and integration.
- Free tier: 100 credits/month, sufficient for processing about 200 pages.
